review: Lobotomy EGO: Hornet Meursault, who will be referred to as Hornet Meursault for the rest of this review, is a Damage Dealer ID from the 7th Walpurgisnacht who primarily specializes in Burn, with a few slivers of Bleed Infliction just for flavor. Starting with his unique effect, which he has plenty of: - Spore is a status that gives Burn Count for every 3 stacks, with a maximum of 3 Burn Count on turn end and 1 Bind next turn. This status does not decay on turn end. - Spore Round [Base] inflicts 2 Spore when spent, while Spore Round [Buckshot] inflicts 3 Spore when spent. His entire mechanic revolves around these two types of Unique Ammo. - Loyalty Pheromone is a buff that stacks up to 3 times, with each stack giving one status of Protection, Haste, Clash Power Up, respectively.
